statement: Fix 0 < γ < 1 and a comparison rate bq ∈ [0, 1]. For the prepared cut constructed above, let η bound the composition budget R, θ + ξ + (log C)/ℓ, all logarithmic class, winner, tail, and label costs, the current mean Eπd1, and the finite classical growth error on the fixed class of lines, after a fixed increase of C∗. The selected endpoint and earlier replacement and composition deficits required in the construction are at most η on their specified current laws, including the two conditional prediction marginals. The common shape and count bins have width at most η; in the isotropic case they also give the error in (11.26). When kf > 0, assume (11.21) under π with its accumulated error αf ≤ η. Finally suppose Pt ≥ Br + 2bqh − ∆. (11.32) Then the prepared statistic P, n(P), W, k under µ satisfies 0 ≤ k ≤ dh + C∗η, k ≥ kf + (4bq − 2γ)h − 2∆ − C∗η, d = ( 1 elongated, 2 isotropic. (11.33) Its pointwise probability bound is (11.27). In the elongated case the continued aperture normal is within Cϵh of n(P). The returned score satisfies (11.25) in that case and (11.26) in the isotropic case. All these bounds are finite at fixed ϵ.
